en-us.jp_mall_cinema_Opt_Apply_greeting: "We need ushers to check tickets and direct patrons. Day shifts pay 1,200 yen an hour, evenings 1,300, and Friday/Saturday late shifts 1,500. Paid daily."
en-us.jp_mall_cinema_Opt_Apply_done: "You're registered for the day shift. You can change shifts in Management's Jobs tab. Late shifts run on Fridays and Saturdays only."
en-us.jp_mall_cinema_Opt_Quit_done: "The paperwork is complete. Thank you for your work here."
en-us.jp_mall_cinema_Opt_cancelLine: "Come back to the counter if you need anything."
